All 18 rules were searched and the plan is submitted. Summary of routing:

- **Located and substantive:** LOL-CAP (consequential waiver p0242, PG non-liability p0126; no monetary cap found), INDEMN (§21.2 p0241 plus §32 settlement-of-claims regime), T4C/RENEWAL/TRANSITION (all converge on §18 duration and realization-of-assets paragraphs p0228–p0235), GOVLAW (§27 Management Committee/arbitration as sole and exclusive remedy; no express choice of law found), ASSIGN (§22 p0246, §30 p0269), IP (asset/capacity ownership §4 and §12; data in §31), LICENSE (Terminal Station Right of Use §11 and IRU), AUDIT (§9 books inspection, 9.8 p0167), LD (§23 default and capacity reclamation), WARRANTY (express no-warranty disclaimers p0126–p0127), INSURANCE (cost-category references only), MINCOMMIT (Minimum Investment Unit and Investment Shares).
- **Likely absent after multiple query passes:** NOSOLICIT (no hits at all), NONCOMPETE, EXCLUSIVITY and MFN (only permissive or even-handed language, which I flagged as favouring us rather than as burdens).

Overlaps are noted rather than double-flagged — notably the §18 exit/forfeiture mechanic, which appears under T4C, RENEWAL, LD and TRANSITION, and the capacity-resale freedoms cited under both NONCOMPETE and EXCLUSIVITY.
